title: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing

entities.name: Geralf Cecani
entities.description: A necromancer and stitcher from Innistrad who writes a monograph on planar magic and retrieves the map to Tarnation with his sister.

entities.name: Gisa Cecani
entities.description: A ghoulcaller from Innistrad who raises the dead by whistling and bickers constantly with her brother Geralf.

entities.name: Stella Lee
entities.description: A Slickshot who wields a lightning whip and helps the Cecani siblings, mourning her friend Lucy Bluff.

entities.name: Lucy Bluff
entities.description: A dead Slickshot buried in Thief's Folly, Stella's friend.

entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: A sharpshooter who warned Stella of ambushes.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: The crew leader who sends the siblings on the mission.

entities.name: Corpsipede
entities.description: A giant centipede made of hundreds of fused corpses, awakened at Thief's Folly by a necromantic trap.

entities.name: Gisa's griffin creature
entities.description: A zombie griffin-manticore Gisa raises to ride.

entities.name: Geralf's jackalope
entities.description: A massive draft jackalope that Geralf borrows as a mount.

entities.name: Geralf's construct
entities.description: A stitched manticore-like construct made from Gisa's griffin, which fights the corpsipede and is rebuilt.

entities.name: Slickshot Gang
entities.description: A criminal gang that encourages loyalty among members.

entities.name: Thief's Folly
entities.description: A vast graveyard of mixed-plane tombs on Thunder Junction, trapped with necromantic sigils.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The plane where the story takes place.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The Cecani siblings' home plane, whose magic is unaffected by Phyrexian invaders.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane where the Omenpaths phenomenon occurred naturally.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Portals that allow non-planeswalkers to travel between planes.

entities.name: Phyrexian invasion
entities.description: The invasion of Innistrad whose forces failed to adapt to its magic.

entities.name: Planar acclimatization
entities.description: Geralf's theory that magic adapts to the rules of a different plane over time.

entities.name: Angel's blood
entities.description: A medicinal substance Geralf needs and Stella provides in a bottle.

entities.name: The map to Tarnation
entities.description: A map hidden in a sealed crypt in Thief's Folly.

events.summary: Gisa raises a griffin-manticore from the ground and Geralf borrows a jackalope, and the siblings ride for Thief's Folly.
events.quote: the two of them were off, riding across the wide-open plains of Thunder Junction toward their distant, unpleasant destination.

events.summary: The siblings camp at night and Geralf observes that Gisa's zombies are not weakening, testing his planar theory.
events.quote: Her wellspring of Innistrad energy had yet to run dry.

events.summary: Geralf wakes Gisa, who fell asleep on watch, and they set off for Thief's Folly with her zombie animals following.
events.quote: They rode off into the dawn, Gisa's mismatched zombie army hopping, scurrying, and slithering after them.

events.summary: The siblings reach Thief's Folly and find it a patchwork of tombs from many planes.
events.quote: The architecture of the tombs and design of the grave markers were a patchwork amalgam of dozens of planes

events.summary: Geralf realizes the grave sigils are an incantation just as Gisa's whistling triggers a trap, and a giant corpsipede erupts.
events.quote: what looked like a centipede made from hundreds of bodies fused together

events.summary: Stella Lee, visiting Lucy Bluff's grave, hears the siblings arguing and meets them.
events.quote: Stella stepped around a crypt, and found herself looking at two pale, dark-haired people in tattered clothing.

events.summary: The corpsipede attacks and all three flee to the necropolis wall.
events.quote: "Run," said the man, grabbing the woman by the arm and charging straight toward Stella.

events.summary: Stella gives Geralf a bottle of angel's blood and lamp oil for free, as she has friends buried in the graveyard.
events.quote: "Then it's on the house." Stella tossed him the bottle

events.summary: Geralf uses the angel's blood to stitch a construct from Gisa's griffin to fight the corpsipede.
events.quote: Wild laughter rose in the distance, followed by Geralf walking back into view, leading a horrifying construct behind him.

events.summary: Gisa whistles to take back her stolen magic from the corpsipede, shrinking it.
events.quote: "There," she said. "I've taken back what's mine."

events.summary: Gisa hums to track the foreign magic and leads them to a sealed Innistradi crypt, which Stella opens with her whip.
events.quote: When it struck the padlock, the shackle popped open and the lock fell away

events.summary: Gisa finds and destroys a beating heart and a centipede in a canopic jar, collapsing the corpsipede.
events.quote: Gisa straightened and stomped on the centipede, grinding it under her toe.

events.summary: Geralf takes the map from the sarcophagus and the group parts ways with Stella.
events.quote: reached inside the sarcophagus, rooting around until he came up with a map.

events.summary: Stella lets the siblings go, and they ride away still bickering.
events.quote: "I suppose there's no captures between friends."

relations.note: The Cecani siblings are brother and sister and constant rivals.
The siblings bicker and mock each other constantly.
relations.quote: "I wouldn't need to walk if you hadn't taken my horse apart."
She couldn't leave Lucy and the other Slickshots who'd gone to the ground for this thing to harvest.

relations.note: Stella was fond of Lucy Bluff and visits her grave.
relations.quote: Stella Lee had been fond of Lucy Bluff

relations.note: Gisa calls the griffin creature out of the ground.
relations.quote: the creature she'd been calling ripped itself out of the earth.

relations.note: Geralf stitches the construct from Gisa's griffin and bodies.
relations.quote: a broad chest formed by stitching at least four smaller bodies together.
